# 1.3.14 Nexus replies

## Gadn (unique weapons and rings; quest item highlight)
Unique weapons and rings are in 1.3.14: switch on Unique Weapons and Unique Equipment under World & Resources, and each one shows at the chest or spot it's in, with its own icon and name. The quest item highlight isn't in yet. And you were right about the fog: the mod never saved it, so it went back to Explored on every start. That's fixed for the next update.

## VintageMarble (filter per region; sarcophagi)
1.3.14 adds a region filter: turn on Settings > Advanced > Region Filter, then pick a region in the Map Key to dim or hide everything outside it. Gold and silver sarcophagi were already tracked: they're part of the Gold Chest and Silver Chest rows.

## Loling91 (altitude, in their thread)
Not quite 1.4.0, but 1.3.14 has it: Settings > Advanced > Position shows your X, Y (height) and Z under the minimap, with a button to copy them.

## izisot (regions in colours)
Done in 1.3.14: Settings > Advanced > Region Colors tints each region in its own colour on the world map.

## TheSefer, BlaineCraner (fossils, paintings, collectibles)
@TheSefer @BlaineCraner Collectibles are in 1.3.14: fossils (both sea lilies included), skeleton pieces, the bard's paintings, Drak reliefs, mosaic pieces and meteorites, 101 in all. They don't respawn, so Ctrl + left click one on the map to mark it found.

## dremen, HadToRegister (Shift+F in a pin's name)
@dremen @HadToRegister Fixed in 1.3.14: a capital F typed into a pin's name no longer opens Find. I kept Shift+F since it matches the game's own search, and Ctrl is dodge.

## Azirael (looted chests coming back)
Yes, a looted chest comes back after 30 minutes with everyone at least 500 m away. To keep them marked for good, set ResetRadius=15000 under [Chests] in minimap_config.ini. 1.3.14's Region Filter can also hide a whole low-level region's chests.

## realkodijack (works on Linux)
Good to know it runs on Linux too, thanks for checking!
